question: How does the speaker identify himself with the Bhṛṅgapādas renowned in the world?
premises: The Bhṛṅgapādas are well known in the world
The speaker declares I am they
This is stated to the boon-granting goddess
inference: The speaker claims identity with the world-renowned Bhṛṅgapādas.
uncertainties: Whether bhṛṅgapādā refers to a group or a title is context-dependent
plain_english: O granter of boons, I am also they, the Bhṛṅgapādas, well known in the world.
